issues.detail: Overview calls retained only for refreshError while the page warns for every retained non-ok sleepState. Cached paused/stale/offline source readings may therefore have an 'Available source readings' brief alongside a source warning (BatteryEvidenceBrief.tsx:39-46). Actual composed status unverified.
issues.fix: Pass an explicit source-derived trust/retained state through the existing feature brief adapter; preserve usable data and distinguish stale, paused and refresh failure without fabricated freshness.

architectureIssues.detail: Page consumes start/end calendar strings and passes them at lines 55-60; shared range hook exposes rolling/timezone-aware instants (useRangeState.ts:110-124,656-668). A 24h selection cannot retain its exact rolling instant semantics through this call. Backend SQL currently uses (from,to] (repo.go:48-58), so an exclusive-upper instant migration also needs boundary agreement.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner must forward startInstant/endInstantExclusive through the typed hook and verify backend half-open boundary semantics, timezone/DST, rolling presets and coverage labels. Preserve the current inclusive UTC disclosure until the contract is actually changed; do not silently relabel calendar data as precise instants.

architectureIssues.detail: Feature imports StatMetric from data-display/stat-reference and LayoutCard from layout/layout-reference (line 5). Directory components similarly import layout-reference at line 5; SleepSectionPlacement imports layout-reference at line 2.
architectureIssues.fix: Use existing public category barrels for available types/components; coordinate useCardPlacement export availability rather than guessing a new shared API. No replacement adapters or component library.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-045 / existing sleep endpoint unit debt
architectureIssues.detail: Sleep wire shape still includes total_minutes, time_to_sleep_avg_min, duration_hours and sentry_monthly_kwh, confirmed by handler.go:69-95,174-195. Capacity is Wh and temperatures are Celsius. This audit must not invent SI replacements or treat existing price-per-kWh context as energy.
architectureIssues.fix: Report to the integration/SI owner for a coordinated typed endpoint migration if authorized; preserve current raw payload/query behavior and every derivation meanwhile. Presentation-only workers must not rename wire fields or change projection arithmetic.
